description: Free-text search of SoundCloud tracks, playlists or albums (e.g. 'melodic techno 2026'). Each result carries BPM and key; prefer values with bpmSource/keySource 'analyzed' (measured from audio) over 'uploader' (tags, often wrong). For a known artist + title, use resolve_track instead.
